title: 5 Daily Habits That Help Manage Diabetes Better
excerpt: Small, consistent changes in diet and routine can make a big difference in blood sugar control.
content: Managing diabetes well is less about dramatic changes and more about consistent daily habits. Regular monitoring, timed meals, light post-meal walks, adequate hydration and stress management all contribute to steadier blood sugar levels. Speak to your physician before adjusting any medication or diet plan.
author: Dr. Anjali Rao

title: Understanding Your Blood Pressure Numbers
excerpt: What do the two numbers on your BP monitor actually mean, and when should you worry?
content: Blood pressure readings consist of systolic and diastolic values. Understanding what's normal versus what warrants medical attention can help you act early. Home monitoring devices make it easy to track trends over time and share accurate data with your doctor.
author: Dr. Suresh Menon

title: Newborn Skincare: What Actually Matters
excerpt: A simple, pediatrician-approved routine for your baby's first few months.
content: Newborn skin is delicate and doesn't need elaborate products. A mild, pH-balanced cleanser, fragrance-free moisturiser and protection from harsh weather cover most needs. Avoid frequent product switching, which can trigger sensitivity.
author: Dr. Neha Kulkarni

title: Do You Really Need a Daily Multivitamin?
excerpt: A practical look at who benefits most from supplementation and who doesn't.
content: Not everyone needs a multivitamin, but certain groups, including those with restrictive diets, high stress, or specific deficiencies, can benefit. Blood tests are the most reliable way to know what your body actually needs rather than guessing.
author: Dr. Anjali Rao
